name: Zheng Yannan
current_role: Founder, Executive Chairman & CEO, Delonix Group (hospitality); founder of 7 Days Inn and Plateno Hotels Group
profile: Most likely Zheng Nanyan (郑南雁, 'Alex Zheng'; Hurun lists the name as 郑雁南), co-founder of Guangzhou budget chain 7 Days Inn (2004/05), which listed on the NYSE in 2009 and was taken private. He then founded Plateno Hotels Group (2013), later sold to Jin Jiang, and since 2022 leads Delonix Group, owner of New Century Hotels and Betterwood Lifestyle Lab.
interesting_fact: 7 Days Inn grew from 5 hotels in 2 cities in 2005 to 283 hotels in 41 cities at its 2009 NYSE IPO, and to about 2,000 hotels in 320 cities by end-2014.
deep_cut_fact: A computer-science graduate of Sun Yat-sen University, he co-founded Armitage Technologies and helped build the Pegasus hotel management system (one of China's top three hotel PMS), then was a VP of Sales & Marketing at Ctrip before founding 7 Days.
notes: Name in Hurun record (Zheng Yannan / 郑雁南) appears to be a transposition of Zheng Nanyan (郑南雁), 7 Days founder; match by company is strong but name differs. Delonix role per Zonebourse aggregator. No personal published contact found; route via Delonix Group corporate communications.

name: Tulsibhai Dholakia
current_role: Co-founder, Hari Krishna Exports / Hari Krishna (HK) Group, Surat diamond & jewellery manufacturer
profile: Tulsibhai (Tulsi Dhanji) Dholakia is one of four brothers (with Savji, Ghanshyam and Himmat) who founded Hari Krishna Exports in 1992, now one of India's largest diamond manufacturers/exporters with operations in Surat, Mumbai, Dubai, New York, Hong Kong and Antwerp. He keeps a low public profile; his brother Savji is the family's public face.
interesting_fact: Hari Krishna became internationally known for rewarding employees with cars and flats as Diwali bonuses, including some 600 cars in 2018.
deep_cut_fact: The four brothers started the Hari Krishna Charitable Trust in 1996, which was expanded in 2024 into the Dholakia Foundation, the HK Group's philanthropic arm; in Nov 2025 Tulsibhai attended the group's mass wedding festival at the HK Hub in Surat.
notes: Very low personal profile; almost all coverage is of brother Savji Dholakia.
